A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Ar2Can and contain readable main text and complete Appendices A-F. Their text, equations, figures and tables support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Ar2Can benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 1-3, plus training curves, quantitative analyses and qualitative experiments in Appendices B, D and E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, training curves and qualitative experiments in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C retain the same Architect variants, Flux-Kontext Artist, Hungarian centroid matching, compositional rewards, token sharing/dropping, curriculum and optional pose-controlled variant.

E1.justification: The training sources, MultiHuman-Testbench and Multi-ID-Test evaluations, and supplementary pose-control and overlapping-face scenarios are unchanged. The renumbered ConsistentID citation still identifies the same single-view data source.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1-3, the appendix tables and qualitative comparisons. No evaluated baseline is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain identical evaluation metrics, sample counts, training budgets, baseline configurations and inference settings, including 1024-by-1024 evaluation resolution.

E4.justification: Table 3 and Appendices D-E retain the same coordinate-sorting, reward-weight, curriculum, group-size, latency, token-sharing, pose-control and face-matching analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical and uncertainty reporting is unchanged in the result tables and training curves. v2 adds no repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including Tables 1-3 and D.1-D.4 and the appendix figures. For example, Table 1 retains Architect-A count accuracy of 90.2 and Architect-B Multi-ID similarity of 68.2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and formulations in Equations 1-9, including the losses, matching objective, curriculum and pose rewards, are unchanged. No theoretical argument or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about spatial/identity decomposition, primarily synthetic training, inference efficiency and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of Architect trade-offs, reward effects and copy-paste artifacts are unchanged. Appendix F retains the limitations concerning individual expression and pose control beyond three people, complex interactions and larger-group scaling.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, preprocessing, inference procedures and resource links remain unchanged. The bibliography revisions introduce no new data-access or reproduction instructions.

R1.justification: The same 43 works remain cited with unchanged research positioning. ConsistentID's preprint-to-journal update and the revised author metadata for ConsistentID and ReCo are bibliographic changes, not additions or removals of prior work.

P1.justification: ConsistentID changes from a 2024 arXiv entry numbered 39 to a 2026 TPAMI entry numbered 16, with revised authors; ReCo's author list and venue formatting also change. Dependent citations and the arXiv version/date are updated, while narrative wording and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: ConsistentID's relocation and revised reference lengths reflow the bibliography across pages 9-10. Figures, tables, captions and their placement remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

improvement.justification: The revision is confined to bibliographic metadata, citation numbering, the version stamp and associated reference-list layout. Methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, interpretations and appendix limitations remain identical, leaving overall paper quality materially unchanged.
